title: Reuse default methods and override selectively
summary: Provide a trait default implemented through a required method, then customize one implementation while retaining the default for another.

contract.clue: Keyword defining a behavior contract that includes a default method

shared.clue: Receiver borrowing the implementer for its required label method

owned.clue: Owned UTF-8 return type for the default caption

formatting.clue: Macro constructing the default caption around the required label result

implementation.clue: Keyword providing the Caption implementation for Plain

forType.clue: Keyword attaching the Caption trait implementation to Plain

uppercase.clue: String-slice method returning an owned uppercase version for the override

bound.clue: Trait bound guaranteeing that render can call the caption method

equal.clue: Macro checking the default caption inherited by Plain
